title: Pack config schema
description: A pack's declared configuration contract as the platform stores it: the pack reference plus the attribute map read from the pack's own config schema file. The attribute descriptors are written in a modified draft-04 dialect, restated here in 2020-12.

pack.description: Reference of the pack this contract belongs to.

attributes.description: The authored file's root map, keyed by attribute name. The names are snake_case because they are read as keyword arguments, not exported into an environment.

attribute.description: One declared attribute. Draft-04 keywords, plus this project's three extensions, plus required-as-a-boolean.

type.description: Declared type. Objects and arrays are permitted, which is what makes this contract nested.

description.description: Shown to the operator filling the value in.

required.description: Draft-03's spelling: a boolean on the property, not a member of an array on the parent. The vendored meta-schema redefines it this way while still identifying itself as draft-04.

default.description: Value used when the operator supplies none. Any JSON type.

secret.description: Project extension. Marks a value to be encrypted at rest and masked on read — this dialect's answer to writeOnly.

immutable.description: Project extension. The value may not be overridden by a caller.

position.description: Project extension. Ordering hint for the rendered form.

items.description: Item schema for an array attribute; an attribute descriptor in its own right.

properties.description: Members of an object attribute — the recursion that makes this contract arbitrarily deep.
